title: Moral Semantics Survive Machine Translation: Cross-Lingual Evidence from Moral Foundations Corpora

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating systematic semantic distortion and translation artifacts introduced by LLM-based machine translation from English to Polish using cross-lingual embedding similarity (LaBSE), Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), LLM-as-judge audits, and classifier parity tests (ROC-AUC gaps).

Measuring translation quality degradation, embedding alignment differences, and predictive performance gaps specifically on subcorpora heavily featuring African American Vernacular English (AAVE), colloquialisms, and slang (e.g., Davidson, ALM, Baltimore datasets).

Analyzing classifier parity gaps across specific moral foundations (e.g., the authority domain) to identify genuine cross-cultural divergence in how moral norms are expressed between English and Polish discourse.
